desc: Not every gun needs to be serious. The Heritage Ranch Hand, available in 44 Magnum, 45 Colt, and 357 Magnum is the perfect example of a gun that's nothing but fun. Offering the same build quality as the incredible Heritage 92, the Ranch Hand decreases the size, and increases the fun. These guns evoke memories of classic westerns, space cowboys, and are guaranteed to bring a smile to your face.
